segments.heading: Warm things
segments.body: The kettle, the toaster and the oven make things warm. Ask your grown-up before going near any of them.
segments.short: The kettle, the toaster and the oven make things warm; ask your grown-up first.

segments.heading: Try it yourself
segments.body: Have the child fill the kettle at the sink and switch it on, then touch the side to feel the warmth.
segments.short: Fill the kettle and switch it on, then touch the side for warmth.

worked_example.short: Point, say warm, then point at the fridge and say cold.

learner_explanation: Look around the kitchen and name one warm and one cold thing.

stimulus.prompt: Ask the child to name one warm and one cold thing.

rubric.description: Child names a warm and a cold object
Child points at one warm object before saying its name
Child gives one cold example from the kitchen

parent_notes: Let the child explore the kitchen freely while you set the table.
learner_explanation_short: Name one warm and one cold thing in the kitchen.
